type.name: Structural Assurability model
type.description: The access, resource, materiality, and capability semantics used to derive Structural Assurability profiles.

type.name: Structural Assurability profile
type.description: The set of evidentiary capabilities available under a Structural Assurability model.

type.name: Assurance context
type.description: A system together with its comparative assurance context.

type.name: Candidate structural dimension
type.description: The current enumeration of candidate structural properties considered by the theory.

type.name: Capability model
type.description: A model connecting claim-relative evidence sets to enabled evidentiary capabilities.

type.name: Unauthorized-action example world
type.description: Possible worlds used by the unauthorized-action claim-resolution example.

type.name: Output-property example capability
type.description: Evidentiary capability used by the externally observable output example.

type.name: Output-property example evidence
type.description: Evidence classes used by the externally observable output example.

type.name: Incomparability example capabilities
type.description: Evidentiary capabilities used by the representative incomparability example.

type.name: Incomparability example evidence
type.description: Evidence classes used by the representative incomparability example.

type.name: Claim
type.description: A proposition evaluated over possible worlds.

type.name: Comparative assurance context
type.description: Claim, evaluator conditions, and resource budget held fixed when comparing systems.

type.name: Conservative-extension witness
type.description: A witness that an extension preserves existing capabilities and provides at least one additional capability.

type.name: Controllability model
type.description: A model of evaluation conditions that can be established and interventions that can be performed.

type.name: Dimension profile
type.description: An extensional set of features associated with a structural property.

type.name: Evaluator conditions
type.description: Knowledge, access, trust, cooperation, and evaluator information relevant to evidence acquisition.

type.name: Evidence access model
type.description: A model of evidence accessibility under evaluator conditions.

type.name: Evidence coverage model
type.description: A model of which assurance-relevant coverage elements are represented by a system.

type.name: Evidence-integrity threat
type.description: A class of threats to evidence integrity represented by the theory.

type.name: Evidence observation model
type.description: An observation model whose observations are evidence sets.

type.name: Evidence set
type.description: A set of evidence artifacts.

type.name: Independence mode
type.description: A mode of evidentiary independence, including independent generation, preservation, or corroboration.

type.name: Independence model
type.description: A model of evidentiary independence relative to subjects and independence modes.

type.name: Integrity model
type.description: A model of evidence-integrity threats that a system detects or prevents.

type.name: Materiality standard
type.description: A claim-relative standard for determining whether evidence is material.

type.name: Observability model
type.description: A model of features observable from a system.

type.name: Observation model
type.description: A model mapping possible worlds to evaluator-visible observations.

type.name: Reconstructability model
type.description: A model of targets that can be reconstructed from the system's evidence environment.

type.name: Representative architecture
type.description: The simplified architecture classes used by the representative Structural Assurability examples.

type.name: Resolution-failure witness
type.description: A pair of admissible observationally indistinguishable worlds that disagree on the selected claim.

type.name: Resource model
type.description: A model of evidence feasibility under system-specific resource bounds.

type.name: Separating construction
type.description: A construction witnessing an assurance-relevant difference associated with a candidate structural dimension.

type.name: Sufficiency standard
type.description: A standard for determining whether an evidence set is sufficient for a claim.

type.name: Traceability model
type.description: A model of evidence-relative traceability to selected targets.

type.name: World space
type.description: A collection of possible worlds together with the predicate identifying those admitted by the analysis.
